FIRST AMENDMENT TO THIS FIRST AMENDMENT TO ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this “Amendment") is entered intoas June // , 2025, by and between PWH GCP LAND LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 215-15 Northern Boulevard, Suite 301, Bayside, New York 11361 (*Developer") and PWH FOXY LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 215-15 Northern Boulevard, Suite 301, Bayside, New York 11361 ("Affordable Developer” and together with the Developer, referred to herein collectively as the “Parties"” and each individually, a “Party"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, the Parties entered into that certain Zoning Lot Development Agreement, dated June 2, 2025, and recorded in the Office of the City Register of the City of New York (the "City's Register") on June 4, 2025, under CRFN 2025000149664 (the “Original ZLDA"; together, with this Amendment, collectively the “ZLDA"); and WHEREAS, the Parties now desire to amend the Original ZLDA to incorporate certain modifications as setforth herein. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the continuing obligations set forth in the Original ZLDA and this Amendment, and the premises and mutual promises set forth herein, and intending to be legally bound hereby, it is agreed as follows: 1. Defined Terms. Capitalized terms used but not otherwise defined in this Amendment shall have the meanings given to such terms in the Original ZLDA. 2. Recitals. (a) The seventh Whereas Clause in the Original ZLDA is hereby deleted in its entirety and replaced with the following: "WHEREAS, Affordable Developer intends to alter and enlarge the existing Affordable Developer Building situated on the Lot 1002 portion of the Affordable Developer Parcel, which shall contain Affordable Senior Housing in an amount that shall be sufficient to satisfy the affordable floor area requirements under MIH Option 1 for the entire Merged Zoning Lot, which affordable floor area shall in no event be less than twenty-five percent (25%) of the total residential floor area of the Developer Building and the Affordable Developer Building; and (b) The eighth Whereas Clause in the Original ZLDA is hereby deleted in its entirety and replaced with the following: "WHEREAS, Developer and Affordable Developer shall execute and record against each of the Developer Parcel and the Affordable Developer Parcel a KL3 3754549.1 Lots - 100l, 10024 230
